description: Implement a guided multi-step artist show flow replacing the /stream page. Any authenticated user linked to an artist profile assigned to an external show sees: show info → mode selection → upload → confirm → live stream. Includes backend schema changes (user_id on artists, start_time on shows, prerecorded upload fields) and new artist-facing API endpoints.

steps.task: Add database migrations: user_id column on artists table, start_time column on shows table, prerecorded upload fields on shows table (prerecorded_key, prerecorded_filename, prerecorded_confirmed_at). Add unique index on artists.user_id.

sub_plan.description: Three ALTER TABLE migrations plus index creation

steps.task: Add migration in ensure_tables(): ALTER TABLE artists ADD COLUMN user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id). Add unique index idx_artist_user_id on artists(user_id) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL.
Add migration: ALTER TABLE shows ADD COLUMN start_time TEXT (stores HH:MM format, nullable).
Add migration: ALTER TABLE shows ADD COLUMN prerecorded_key TEXT, ALTER TABLE shows ADD COLUMN prerecorded_filename TEXT, ALTER TABLE shows ADD COLUMN prerecorded_confirmed_at TEXT.

decisions: user_id on artists (not artist_id on users) — keeps user table clean, artist profile owns the link
start_time as separate TEXT HH:MM (not modifying existing date column) — minimal migration impact
Separate prerecorded_key fields (not reusing recording_key) — prevents artist uploads from overwriting admin recordings
learnings: Existing migration pattern uses run_migration() helper with IF NOT EXISTS checks in db.rs ensure_tables()
knowledge.notes: Follow existing migration pattern: check column existence before ALTER TABLE to make migrations idempotent.

output.summary: Completed: Add database migrations: user_id column on artists table, start_time column on s

Flattened linked_artist into linked_artist_id + linked_artist_name on UserListItem via LEFT JOIN (simpler than nested struct for sqlx::FromRow)

steps.task: Create prerecorded upload endpoints under /api/my-show/upload: init, chunk, finalize (chunked path) and direct POST (small file path). Mirror existing upload_recording_chunked.rs pattern but store to prerecorded/ R2 prefix and update shows.prerecorded_key/prerecorded_filename. Add POST /api/my-show/confirm and DELETE /api/my-show/upload.

sub_plan.description: Implement upload and confirm endpoints for artist prerecorded flow

steps.task: Create POST /api/my-show/upload/init: auth as any user, resolve user → artist → show, create pending upload session (reuse pending_recording_uploads table with upload_type='prerecorded'). Return session_id.
Create POST /api/my-show/upload/chunk/:session_id: validate session belongs to user's show, store chunk in R2 at pending-prerecorded/{session_id}/chunk-{index}.
Create POST /api/my-show/upload/finalize/:session_id: assemble chunks, upload to prerecorded/{show_id}/{filename} in R2, update shows.prerecorded_key and prerecorded_filename, cleanup pending data.
Create POST /api/my-show/upload (small file ≤50MB): direct multipart upload to prerecorded/ prefix, update show fields.

Create POST /api/my-show/confirm: set shows.prerecorded_confirmed_at = now(). Only if prerecorded_key is set. Create DELETE /api/my-show/upload: clear prerecorded_key, prerecorded_filename, prerecorded_confirmed_at, delete R2 object.

decisions: Mirror existing chunked upload pattern from upload_recording_chunked.rs for consistency
Store under prerecorded/ R2 prefix to separate from admin recordings
Auth uses get_current_user() — any authenticated user — but verifies user is linked to an artist with an assigned show
learnings: Existing chunked upload uses pending_recording_uploads and pending_recording_chunks tables with 2-hour expiry
knowledge.notes: May add upload_type column to pending_recording_uploads to distinguish admin vs artist uploads, OR create separate pending_prerecorded_uploads table. TBD during implementation.
